options.label: Name keychain
options.description: A name with an outline that follows the letters and a loop

options.label: Layered keychain
options.description: The name cut from one colour, glued on a backer

options.label: Connected text
options.description: A name welded into one cut piece, bridged where letters part

options.label: Symbol charm
options.description: An icon outlined, with a loop

options.label: Name tag
options.description: Lettering on a heart, disc, bone, shield or banner

options.label: Pet ID tag
options.description: A pet's name and your number on a bone or tag

options.label: Pattern fill
options.description: A shape filled with a pattern, a monogram in the middle

options.label: Arc coaster
options.description: Text curved round the rim, a monogram in the middle

options.label: Framed ornament
options.description: A name across a ring frame on a dark backer

options.label: Cake topper
options.description: Up to three lines welded together on stakes

options.label: Plant stake
options.description: The plant's name on top of a garden stake

options.label: Place cards
options.description: A folding card for each name on your list

options.label: Luggage tag
options.description: A strap-slot tag per name, with contact details

options.label: QR tag
options.description: A code, two lines and a loop

options.label: Jigsaw
options.description: A puzzle in the shape and number of pieces you pick

parameters.name: text
parameters.label: Text
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'cake-topper' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'jigsaw'
parameters.description: For place cards and luggage tags, one name per line. A cake topper takes up to three lines.

parameters.name: text2
parameters.label: Second line
parameters.showIf: design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag'
parameters.description: The phone number, the bottom of the rim, the year, the variety, contact details or the line under the code.

parameters.name: monogram
parameters.label: Middle
parameters.description: A monogram or short word in the middle.

parameters.name: font
parameters.label: Font
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'cake-topper' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'jigsaw'

parameters.name: font2
parameters.label: Second font
parameters.showIf: design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster'

parameters.name: size
parameters.label: Letter height
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'cake-topper' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'jigsaw'
parameters.description: The height of a capital letter. Lettering on a shape shrinks to fit.

parameters.name: size2
parameters.label: Second letter height
parameters.showIf: design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster'

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.label: Letter spacing
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'cake-topper' || design == 'plant-stake' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag' || design == 'jigsaw'

parameters.name: weight
parameters.label: Boldness
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'framed-ornament' || design == 'cake-topper' || design == 'plant-stake'
parameters.description: Thickens the letters so they weld together.

parameters.name: op
parameters.label: Laser
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'jigsaw'
parameters.description: Cut through only on a name tag; elsewhere it engraves.

parameters.name: shape
parameters.label: Shape
parameters.description: A coaster is a circle or a scalloped circle; a jigsaw a rectangle, heart, circle, oval or rounded square.

parameters.name: tagHeight
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: For rectangles, pills, ovals and squircles, luggage tags and QR tags; other shapes keep their own proportions.

parameters.name: border
parameters.label: Border
parameters.description: The rim or the plain edge round a pattern.

parameters.name: cardHeight
parameters.label: Card height
parameters.description: Of the face that stands; the card is twice this before folding.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.label: Margin
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'place-cards' || design == 'luggage-tag' || design == 'qr-tag'
parameters.description: Round the letters on an outline, or in from the edge of a shape.

parameters.name: smooth
parameters.label: Smoothing
parameters.description: Closes the dips between letters in the outline.

parameters.name: web
parameters.label: Web
parameters.description: The least material between two cut-outs.

parameters.name: qrData
parameters.label: Code
parameters.description: A link, Wi-Fi details or any text.

parameters.name: ecc
parameters.label: Error correction
parameters.description: Higher survives scratches but needs more squares.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Shuffle
parameters.description: Another number gives other knob directions.

parameters.name: ring
parameters.label: Keyring
parameters.showIf: design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'qr-tag'

parameters.name: ringSide
parameters.label: Side
parameters.showIf: (design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill') && ring != 'none'

parameters.name: holeDiameter
parameters.label: Hole
parameters.showIf: (design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'qr-tag') && ring != 'none' || design == 'framed-ornament'

parameters.name: ringWall
parameters.label: Wall round the hole
parameters.showIf: (design == 'name-keychain' || design == 'layered-keychain' || design == 'connected-text' || design == 'symbol-charm' || design == 'name-tag' || design == 'pet-tag' || design == 'pattern-fill' || design == 'arc-coaster' || design == 'qr-tag') && ring != 'none' || design == 'framed-ornament'

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.label: Sheet thickness
parameters.description: For the 3D view, and the width of the bridges in connected text.

parameters.name: kerf
parameters.label: Kerf
parameters.description: Half of it is added round every cut outline. Leave at 0 for keychains and tags; set it for puzzles and parts that fit together.

parameters.name: spacingSheet
parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.description: Between pieces and from the sheet's edge.
